events.text: For the first time you feel your internal energy move on its own, a warm thread circling below your navel.

effects.log: You follow it for an hour. It is like listening to your own heartbeat for the first time.
It scatters. You gather it again, humbler.

events.text: Now that you are Third-Rate, small-time bandits cross the road when they see you. You are not sure how they know.

effects.log: You walk a little taller. The bandits walk a little faster.
If bandits can tell, so can masters. You train harder.

events.text: A farmer's cart is stuck under a fallen boulder. Before, you could never have moved it. Now...

ok.log: It rolls. The farmer stares at you like a god.

fail.log: It moves a hand-width. Enough for the cart. Not enough for your pride.

effects.log: Physics is also a martial art.

events.text: You find you can jump onto a low wall without thinking.

effects.log: The neighbours are not pleased. Your lightness skill improves.
Some tricks are better when nobody knows.

events.text: Your hearing has sharpened. You can hear conversations three rooms away.

effects.log: You learn more gossip in one night than in a year.
Harder than listening, and more polite.

events.text: Sect disciples now bow to you on the road. A year ago they would have walked past you.

effects.log: Courtesy costs nothing and remembers everything.
They whisper about how aloof you are. It is almost flattering.

events.text: In a spar, you feel your qi flare instinctively to take a blow. It barely stings.

effects.log: You learn to call it on purpose. Almost.

choices.text: Get hit on purpose to test it

effects.log: You test it. It works nine times out of ten. The tenth hurts.

events.text: A village asks you to teach its young men to defend against bandits.

effects.log: Twenty farmers with sticks, very determined. The bandits choose another village.

choices.text: Refuse: you are still learning yourself

effects.log: Honest. The village finds someone else.

events.text: Your sword hums when you draw it, a faint vibration of your qi in the steel.

effects.log: By winter the hum is a clear note. Your swordwork is sharper.
A hidden edge is sharper than a loud one.

events.text: A First-Rate swordsman challenges you, 'to see if the rumours are true'.

ok.log: The rumours were true. He bows and leaves.

fail.log: He wins, narrowly, and says the rumours were almost true.

effects.log: He respects it. Some masters do.

events.text: You run across the rooftops of the town at night without making a sound.

choices.text: Go all the way to the river

effects.log: The whole town beneath you, asleep. You feel like a ghost.

choices.text: Stop at the temple roof and meditate

effects.log: Under the stars, above the world.

events.text: A youngster follows you for three days, begging to be your disciple.

effects.log: A disciple, just like that, with a very large appetite.

choices.text: Send the youngster to a sect

effects.log: Off they go, a little disappointed. A letter comes from the sect, some time later.

events.text: People stop talking when you enter a room now. You have not said anything.

effects.log: You smile more. It helps, a little.
Negotiations have never been so easy.

events.text: You catch a falling leaf between two fingers without looking.

effects.log: A whole autumn in your hand.
Sometimes the leaf should fall.

events.text: An old enemy from your youth bows to you on the street. The bow is very deep.

effects.log: The past is the past. He is almost crying.
He stays bowed until you are gone.

events.text: Three sects send you invitations to be a guest elder. The letters all say the same flattering things.

effects.log: A season of respect and good food. (40 taels)
The murim notes your independence.

events.text: You can feel the weather change a day before it does. Farmers begin to ask you when to plant.

effects.log: The best harvest in years. You are a village legend.
The farmers plant late. The harvest is fine anyway.

events.text: You realise you no longer need a sword. Anything in your hand is a sword. A chopstick is a sword.

effects.log: You cut a candle flame with a chopstick. The innkeeper faints.

choices.text: Put the sword away for a season

effects.log: You feel lighter, and more dangerous.

events.text: Young challengers arrive weekly now. Most of them are very brave and very bad.

choices.text: Teach each one something before sending them home

effects.log: The murim is better for it. You are very tired.

choices.text: Put up a sign: "Closed for training"

effects.log: Nobody believes the sign. It is a nice sign.

events.text: There are perhaps ten people in the empire who could match you. You have met three. You are very lonely.

effects.log: Long journeys, strange friendships. Worth it.
You fill the loneliness with students.

events.text: Wild animals come to you now. A deer eats from your hand. A tiger lies down near your door.

effects.log: The mountain becomes very peaceful around your house.
You are a person, not a shrine.

events.text: Your hair has started to grow dark again at the roots. Harmony is changing your body from inside.

effects.log: The change deepens.
You look forty years younger. Your old friends are furious.

events.text: Two sects are about to fight at the river. You walk into the middle and sit down. Nobody moves.

effects.log: The fight becomes a banquet. Both leaders owe you.
They leave. The river flows. Nobody knows what happened.

events.text: You can hear the qi of everything: trees, stones, the sleeping cat.

effects.log: A day of listening. You understand the world a little better.
You hear their fears. You become kinder.

events.text: The Emperor himself sends an envoy asking for your blessing on his heir.

effects.log: The heir grows up remembering the day a Mystic master touched his head.
The court argues about its meaning for a year.

events.text: At Life and Death, one breath lasts as long as you want it to.

effects.log: The world waits for you. It is very patient.
You choose to be ordinary for a while. It is a gift.

events.text: At the edge of the world's strength, you realise the only thing left worth doing is to teach.

effects.log: A thousand students in ten years. Some of them will surpass you. Good.

choices.text: Choose one student and teach everything

effects.log: One perfect heir.
